_comment: Per-package coverage floors (TP-10). scripts/lint/coverage_ratchet.py fails a PR whose measured coverage is below a floor, or that lowers a floor already on the base branch. Raising floors is a manual 'measure' then 'update' run, never automatic in CI. 'target' is the plan's goal (test-plan-2026-09.md 4.1) and does not gate.
reason: Initial floors: measured baseline (branch mode, whole gate), rounded down to one decimal. To lower a floor, add a line 'coverage-floor-lowered: <why>' to this field.
